Orhan (1067937): score.raw=46.5, score.display='★★★☆☆ (47)', 3 stars; distance=662.5 km; trips=45; 7 daily entries; 54 recent_events with ts/day/time/address/lat/lng/penalty/kind. per_100km invariant verified for braking/acceleration/turning/speeding (count/distance*100 = per_100km within 0.05). Audit lists all Navixy calls (employee/list, tracker/list, report/tracker/generate plugin 46, status/retrieve/delete, track/list). Second identical call returns cache hit (age~206s, <3s response). Sources footer mentions 'plugin 46'. Filters: all=6 rows, without_vehicle=4 rows all with status-no-vehicle badges. Search 'Orhan' → 1 row. Drawer opens for Orhan: score '★★★☆☆ (41)' native, drawer-why-score + reason-braking/acceleration/turning/idling/speeding + penalty-summary + drawer-daily-chart + drawer-events all present. 60 event-map-link-* entries linking to https://www.google.com/maps?q=lat,lng. drawer-close removes drawer. Clicking a without-vehicle driver shows drawer-no-vehicle block. unassigned-vehicles section shows 3 cards, data-sources footer present. sort-name/score/distance/events all present. Regression: overview, analyse, vehicles, costs tabs load without errors.
action_items: MINOR / Recharts warning still emitted on mount ('width(-1) height(-1) should be greater than 0') — same finding as iteration 9, non-blocking. Set explicit minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parents or delay chart mount until layout is measured.
critical_code_review_comments: ecodriving.py: for the 'idling' event kind the payload exposes 'min_per_100km' instead of 'per_100km' (other kinds use per_100km). Non-blocking (front-end handles both) but inconsistent — consider adding a 'per_100km' key alongside 'min_per_100km' for schema uniformity.
